About GenScript 

 Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions. 

 Job Title: Enterprise AI Agent Development Engineer

 Supervisor: Head of AI for Industry, Digital & Intelligent Technology Center

 Location: Piscataway, NJ (Onsite)

 Compensation: Targeting $150,000 - $180,000 based on experience level.

 Key Responsibilities

 
 Design, develop, test, and continuously optimize enterprise AI Agents.

 Build capabilities such as task planning, tool calling, and workflow orchestration using large language models.

 Integrate AI Agents with enterprise systems, including ERP, CRM, OA, supply chain, and order management systems, to automate cross-system business processes.

 Develop and optimize enterprise system interfaces and Agent tools.

 Collaborate with product and business teams to deploy AI Agent solutions in real-world enterprise scenarios.

 
 Qualifications

 
 Master’s degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field, and at least 3 years work experience.

 Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in Java and Python.

 Experience in large language model application development, with an understanding of prompt engineering and function calling.

 Hands-on experience with Agent development frameworks, particularly LangGraph and Agent Scope.

 Familiarity with APIs, databases, microservices, and common enterprise system integration methods.

 Strong system design, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

 Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 Experience developing and deploying enterprise AI Agent solutions.

 Experience integrating ERP, CRM, OA, supply chain, or order management systems.

 Familiarity with MCP, OAuth 2.0, SSO, and RBAC.

 Experience with complex workflow orchestration, multi-Agent collaboration, or private deployment of large language models.

 
 #LI-EB1

 #GS
 Benefits: 

 Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match that vests fully on day one. We offer paid parental leave after just three (3) months of employment, and a paid time off policy that includes vacation time, personal time, sick time, floating holidays, and company holidays. Additional benefits include flexible spending and health savings accounts, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, legal assistance, and supplemental plans such as pet, critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance. We also provide commuter benefits, well-being initiatives, and peer-to-peer recognition programs; demonstrating our ongoing commitment to building a culture where our people feel empowered, supported, and inspired to do their best work. 

 GenScript USA Inc/ProBio Inc. is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to attracting, retaining, and maximizing the performance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the Company's policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status, uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

 GenScript USA Inc./ProBio Inc. maintains a drug-free workplace. 

  

 Please note: Genscript USA Inc./ProBio Inc. will only contact candidates through verified application sources. GenScript/Probio does not request personal information from candidates through individual email or any other platform.
